# Favionus
> Turnkey onshore wind LiDAR measurement campaigns. Bankable, quality-controlled wind data for developers, lenders and engineers.

Favionus plans, deploys, monitors and delivers IEC-classified vertical profiling LiDAR campaigns for wind resource assessment, met mast complement, repowering and site investigation.

- Location: Bucharest, Romania — campaigns across Europe

- https://favionus.com/repowering-wind-measurement/

## Standards & keywords
IEC-classified LiDAR, vertical profiling, bankable wind data, remote monitoring, quality-controlled datasets, energy yield assessment support.
